acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Fungalfolk family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Sporeguard, T3, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Breathing-Cloud Specialist (Specialist) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two water construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Wide luminous cap, visible mycelium veins under translucent skin, and the first constant thin shoulder spore cloud.
Signature mechanic: Two-Breath Guard: shoulder spores alternately inhale along bright mycelium veins and exhale through the wide luminous cap, reversing safe movement.
battlefieldDuty: Qualitatively pivot into a controller that writes inhaling and exhaling lanes through a constant thin spore cloud.
constructionDimensions: Tier-safe anatomy: T1 has no glow, no constant spore cloud, no smaller mushrooms, no throne, and no ground network; T2 alone adds faint gill glow; T3 adds its constant spore cloud; T4 adds smaller mushrooms; T5 adds throne and ground network.
Capillary mycelium, wet reflective cap tissue, pressurized gill valves, coherent droplets, mist release, and visible drainage distinguish Water affinity from a native damp habitat.
counterplay: Move with the visible breath direction and cut the dim opposite vein during the reversal. Affinity signal: Tier-safe anchors: T1 has no glow, no constant spore cloud, no smaller mushrooms, no throne, and no ground network, so pressure loss exposes its stalk; T2 faint gill glow dims at a valve; T3 constant spore cloud clears around intake; T4 smaller mushrooms drain through the active stem; T5 throne and ground network expose the empty node.
forbiddenTreatments: Treating damp habitat as Water affinity
identityInvariants: Cap-headed, stalk-bodied silhouette with gills, bulbous limbs, and a wider top than base remains recognizable.
Pale fungal flesh and one strong cap tone contrast with bounded cyan or green gill bioluminescence from T2 onward.
Fungal flesh, spongy cap, mycelium, damp moss, and spore dust remain organic and spatially coherent.
Cap breadth, gill light, spore density, secondary growth, and ground mycelium escalate at explicit source tiers.
telegraph: One side's veins brighten under translucent skin as its constant cloud narrows toward the gills.
